o.norm:
Test of solver for the exponential function.

It takes 10 to 15 iterations for the last two tests to converge. In fact, if not for the bisection alternative, the solver would exceed the default maximal iteration of 100.

i.norm: Tests that {@link MullerSolver} correctly finds the root of the expm1 function (i.e., e^x - 1 = 0, whose only real root is x = 0) across search intervals of increasing width. Wide intervals require bisection fallback to converge within the 100-iteration budget.
Medium interval: may need several iterations
Wide interval: requires bisection fallback to stay within MAX_ITERATIONS
Verifies that {@code solver} finds the expected root (x = 0) of {@code f} within [{@code min}, {@code max}] using at most {@value #MAX_ITERATIONS} evaluations.
